key_findings: Existing state and audit reads wait on Runtime; independent committed view needed to serve useful diagnostics under WAL stall.
Read and Audit are separate permissions; require both for one-profile package and bind every page to actual UID/profile.
Existing bounded labels, principals, device fingerprints, TCP tuples and doctor String fields require an explicit diagnostic projection.
Health/log observation times differ from committed state; preserve previous epoch, loss/gap, operation/cleanup and historical proof boundaries.
Accepted log reads stay with two real readers plus two queued slots after observer cancellation; no detached filesystem or doctor task may be claimed cancelled.
execution: Read-only source and read-only Git blob comparisons
reviewer_participation: Author of service/logging components; source-method cross-review, not independent implementation audit.
limits: Proposed API, quotas and tests were not compiled or executed. Parent will select final API before implementation. No hardware or cleanup claims from diagnostics.
